SAMPLE_FROST_SHARD.title: Frost Shard
SAMPLE_FROST_SHARD.description: Reference sample (Tier A, MergeAmount). Adds Block equal to twice the merged stack amount.
SAMPLE_RETAIN_AURA.title: Retain Aura
SAMPLE_RETAIN_AURA.description: Reference sample (Tier A, ExistenceStack). Adds the [gold]Retain[/gold] keyword once; re-applying the enchantment is a no-op.
SAMPLE_STATE_ACCUMULATOR.title: State Accumulator
SAMPLE_STATE_ACCUMULATOR.description: Reference sample (Tier A, DuplicateInstance). Each application keeps an independent instance with its own runtime state.
SAMPLE_COST_REDUCER.title: Cost Reducer
SAMPLE_COST_REDUCER.description: Reference sample (Tier B, MergeAmount with companion definition). Lowers the card's [gold]Energy[/gold] cost by 1 every time it is enchanted.
SAMPLE_EXHAUST_ADDER.title: Exhaust Adder
SAMPLE_EXHAUST_ADDER.description: Reference sample (Tier B, keyword contribution). Contributes the [gold]Exhaust[/gold] keyword as a stackable source.
SAMPLE_CONDITIONAL_EXHAUST.title: Conditional Exhaust
SAMPLE_CONDITIONAL_EXHAUST.description: Reference sample (Tier B, conditional keyword). Contributes [gold]Exhaust[/gold] only when the stack amount reaches a threshold.
SAMPLE_NONLINEAR_ENCHANTMENT.title: Nonlinear Enchant
SAMPLE_NONLINEAR_ENCHANTMENT.description: Reference sample (Tier B, custom presentation). Demonstrates overriding extra-card-text formatting and visual slice amounts.
SAMPLE_DYNAMIC_ENCHANTMENT.title: Dynamic Enchant
SAMPLE_DYNAMIC_ENCHANTMENT.description: Reference sample (Tier C, fluent registration). Registered at runtime without an attribute or companion class.
SAMPLE_COMBAT_GUARD.title: Combat Guard
SAMPLE_COMBAT_GUARD.description: Reference sample (Tier A, Scope = UntilCombatEnds). Removed at the end of the current combat with RemovalReason.CombatEnded.
SAMPLE_SINGLE_TURN_SHARPEN.title: Single-Turn Sharpen
SAMPLE_SINGLE_TURN_SHARPEN.description: Reference sample (Tier A, Scope = UntilTurnEnds). Removed at the end of the current player turn with RemovalReason.TurnEnded.
SAMPLE_LINGERING_SHARPEN.title: Lingering Sharpen
SAMPLE_LINGERING_SHARPEN.description: Reference sample (Tier C, LingerForTurns(2)). Survives two player turns, then is removed with RemovalReason.TurnLimitReached.
SAMPLE_CHARGED_SHARPEN.title: Charged Sharpen
SAMPLE_CHARGED_SHARPEN.description: Reference sample (Tier C, MaxActivations(3, OnPlay)). Removed after three plays with RemovalReason.ActivationLimitReached; the first removal attempt is vetoed once for demonstration.
SAMPLE_HAND_ONLY_SHARPEN.title: Hand-Only Sharpen
SAMPLE_HAND_ONLY_SHARPEN.description: Reference sample (Tier C, ConditionalActive). Contributes to damage / block only while the host card sits in the player's hand.
SAMPLE_LIFECYCLE_ENCHANTMENT.title: Lifecycle Showcase
SAMPLE_LIFECYCLE_ENCHANTMENT.description: Reference sample (Tier B, UntilCombatEnds + full lifecycle override surface). Demonstrates OnApplied, OnRemoved (with veto), OnCombatStart / OnCombatEnd and OnTurnStart / OnTurnEnd.
SAMPLE_PLUS_FIVE.title: Plus Five
SAMPLE_PLUS_FIVE.description: Reference sample (Tier A, [ModifyDynamicVar]). Adds 5 × stack amount to the card's [gold]Damage[/gold]. Stacks with other ModifyDynamicVar contributions in application order.
SAMPLE_DOUBLER.title: Doubler
SAMPLE_DOUBLER.description: Reference sample (Tier B, [ModifyDynamicVar] on companion definition). Doubles the card's [gold]Damage[/gold]. Apply alongside Plus Five to see order-sensitive composition: (base+5)×2 ≠ (base×2)+5.
SAMPLE_UNREGISTERED.title: Unregistered Enchant
SAMPLE_UNREGISTERED.description: Reference sample (compatibility, no Register call). Overrides EnchantDamageAdditive to demonstrate the auto-registration safety net — first encounter auto-registers as MergeAmount with a one-time info log.
TWO_PLAY_FREE_ENCHANT.title: 打出两次后免费
TWO_PLAY_FREE_ENCHANT.description: 打出若干次后变为免费
SAMPLE_EMBER.title: Ember
SAMPLE_EMBER.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnCardDiscarded + MergeAmount). Deals damage equal to stack amount to a random enemy when the host card is discarded.
SAMPLE_EMBER.extraCardText: On discard: deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
SAMPLE_SAMSARA.title: Samsara
SAMPLE_SAMSARA.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnCardExhausted). When the host card is exhausted, it returns to the draw pile instead of staying in the exhaust pile.
SAMPLE_WEB_TRAP.title: Web Trap
SAMPLE_WEB_TRAP.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnCardChangedPiles + MergeAmount). When the host card leaves the hand and enters the discard pile, applies Weakness equal to stack amount to a random enemy.
SAMPLE_CHARGE_UP.title: Charge Up
SAMPLE_CHARGE_UP.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnSideTurnStart(Enemy) + MergeAmount). At the start of each enemy turn, increases the enchantment's stack count — adding +2 base damage per stack permanently.
SAMPLE_PHOENIX.title: Phoenix
SAMPLE_PHOENIX.description: Reference sample (Tier C, OnShouldDie). A lethal hit is prevented, the owner heals 50% MaxHp, and the enchantment removes itself.
SAMPLE_FULL_HP_SHIELD.title: Full HP Shield
SAMPLE_FULL_HP_SHIELD.description: Reference sample (Tier C, ConditionalActive + ModifyDynamicVar). Adds +5 Block while the owner is at full HP; the enchantment deactivates (not removed) when HP drops below maximum.
SAMPLE_TEMPO_TRACKER.title: Tempo Tracker
SAMPLE_TEMPO_TRACKER.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnAnyCardPlayed broadcast hook). Counts every card played in the combat — including self — via the broadcast variant of OnCardPlayed.
SAMPLE_RESONATOR.title: Resonator
SAMPLE_RESONATOR.description: Reference sample (Tier B, OnSiblingApplied / OnSiblingRemoved). Buffs itself by +1 stack for every other enchantment on the same card, refunding when neighbors leave.
SAMPLE_CHARGED_SURGE.title: Charged Surge
SAMPLE_CHARGED_SURGE.description: Reference sample (Tier C, ScopeRuntimeStateView + FormatExtraText). Adds +5 [gold]Damage[/gold] for three plays; tooltip pulls the remaining-charge count from the snapshot's ScopeStates.
SAMPLE_BERSERK.title: Berserk
SAMPLE_BERSERK.description: Reference sample (Tier C, NotifyPropsChanged). Damage scales with missing HP; OnAfterDamageReceived mutates a cached field and explicitly refreshes derived UI state.
SAMPLE_BOUNDED_QUEUE.title: Bounded Queue
SAMPLE_BOUNDED_QUEUE.description: Reference sample (Tier C, MaxInstances + StackOverflowPolicy.ReplaceOldest). Caps at 5 live instances per card; the oldest instance is evicted with RemovalReason.OverflowEvicted on overflow.
SAMPLE_FLEXIBLE_SCOPE.title: Flexible Scope
SAMPLE_FLEXIBLE_SCOPE.description: Reference sample (Tier C, per-instance scope override). Registry default is permanent, but individual applications can pass a shorter scope to MultiEnchantmentApi.Enchant or change it with SetScopeOverride.
SAMPLE_FLEXIBLE_SCOPE.extraCardText: Scope can be overridden per application.
SAMPLE_SCALED_ON_PLAY_ONCE.title: Single Settlement
SAMPLE_SCALED_ON_PLAY_ONCE.description: Reference sample (Tier A, HookExecutionMode.PerLiveInstance). When legacy OnPlay already scales by Amount, run only the merged anchor once to avoid quadratic scaling.
SAMPLE_SCALED_ON_PLAY_ONCE.extraCardText: Legacy OnPlay: resolves once using the total stack.
SAMPLE_PER_STACK_ON_PLAY.title: Per-Stack Settlement
SAMPLE_PER_STACK_ON_PLAY.description: Reference sample (Tier B, HookExecutionMode.MergedTotal). When legacy OnPlay represents one layer of effect per call, run it once per active stack.
SAMPLE_PER_STACK_ON_PLAY.extraCardText: Legacy OnPlay: resolves once per stack.
SAMPLE_HEAVY_PLATING.title: Heavy Plating
SAMPLE_HEAVY_PLATING.description: Reference sample (Tier A, [ModifyEnergyCost]). Uses a folded cost contribution so each stack adds +1 combat energy cost and multiple enchantments compose cleanly.
SAMPLE_EXTRA_SWING.title: Extra Swing
SAMPLE_EXTRA_SWING.description: Reference sample (Tier A, [ModifyCardPlayCount]). Uses a folded play-count contribution so each stack adds one extra play, suitable for ExtraHit-style effects.
SAMPLE_NUMERIC_CONTRIBUTION_REGISTRATION: Reference sample (Tier C, fluent numeric contributions). Declares combat energy-cost and play-count contributions directly on the Register chain without attributes.
SAMPLE_STACKED_TACTICS.title: Stacked Tactics
SAMPLE_STACKED_TACTICS.description: Reference sample (Tier B, stack-aware async hooks). Demonstrates OnPlayStacked, Before/AfterCardPlayedStacked, AfterAnyCardDrawnStacked, BeforeFlushStacked, and AfterDamageGivenStacked aggregation semantics.
SAMPLE_STACKED_TACTICS.extraCardText: Aggregates by enchantment type instead of repeating prompts or random rolls per stack.
SAMPLE_HAND_STATUS_SHARPEN.title: Hand Status Sharpen
SAMPLE_HAND_STATUS_SHARPEN.description: Reference sample (Tier C, WhenActiveStatus). The enchantment lasts two turns, but is active only while the host card is in hand; outside the hand the badge darkens and contributes no value.
SAMPLE_FRAMEWORK_EVENTS.title: Framework Event Recorder
SAMPLE_FRAMEWORK_EVENTS.description: Reference sample (Tier B, HistoryDisplay + OnRestored + broadcast events). Demonstrates combat-history grouping, save/sync restore, any-card draw/exhaust/discard broadcasts, and block events.
SAMPLE_ALTERNATING_BADGES.title: Alternating Badges
SAMPLE_ALTERNATING_BADGES.description: Reference sample (Tier B, per-badge status and icon presentation). Odd rounds light the first badge; even rounds light the second.
SAMPLE_ALTERNATING_BADGES.extraCardText: Alternates between two badge states and icons.
SAMPLE_LIBRARY_MARKER.title: Library Marker
SAMPLE_LIBRARY_MARKER.description: Reference sample (display-only extra icon). Shows a marker icon from card UI refreshes, including card-library and preview cards without live enchantment instances.
